evidence.note: Refrigerator door is closed immediately before the manipulation.
Door is being pulled open; the user's hand is visible at its edge.
Refrigerator interior and door shelves are exposed.
User grasps the open door and begins swinging it closed.
Door is nearly closed during the closing motion.
Refrigerator is visibly closed.
Built-in dishwasher door is closed.
User pulls the dishwasher handle and starts lowering the door.
Dishwasher door is lowered and the racks are visible.
Dishwasher remains open.
User raises the dishwasher door by its handle.
Dishwasher is subsequently visible closed.
Range oven door is closed.
User pulls the oven door downward.
Oven door is fully lowered and the cavity is exposed.
Oven remains open.
User lifts the oven door toward the closed position.
Oven door is closed.
User reaches for the tall pantry door beside the refrigerator.
Pantry door is open and its shelves are exposed.
Pantry remains open.
User swings the pantry door shut.
Pantry facade is closed and flush.

events.object_description: Tall pantry cabinet door immediately left of the refrigerator

evidence.note: User reaches to the upper cabinet above the toaster-side counter.
The paired cabinet doors are open and the interior shelves are visible.
Cabinet remains open.
User pushes the open door assembly toward the cabinet face.
Cabinet doors are closed and flush.

events.object_description: Left upper double-door cabinet above the toaster-side counter

evidence.note: Right-side upper cabinet above the knife-block counter is closed.
A cabinet leaf has been swung open, exposing shelves of food.
Cabinet interior is fully exposed with the paired doors open.
Cabinet remains open.
User pushes the right leaf closed.
Both cabinet faces are closed and aligned.

events.object_description: Right upper double-door cabinet above the knife-block counter

evidence.note: User grasps the closed black pressure-cooker lid.
Lid has been removed and placed beside the open cooker body.
Cooker body and lid remain separated.
User lifts the detached lid toward the cooker body.
Lid is seated on the cooker again.

events.object_description: Black electric pressure cooker removable lid

evidence.note: Mint-green rice cooker lid is closed.
User has lifted the hinged lid.
Rice cooker is visibly open.
User lowers the hinged lid.
Rice cooker lid is fully closed.

events.object_description: Mint-green countertop rice cooker hinged lid

evidence.note: User grasps the air-fryer basket handle while it is seated.
Basket drawer has been pulled out, exposing the fryer cavity.
User begins pushing the extended basket back into the appliance.
Basket is nearly fully seated during the push.
Air-fryer basket is fully inserted and closed.

notes: Closed configurations are treated as off and open, removed, or extended configurations as on. Each paired upper cabinet is represented as one synchronized access episode because the two leaves change state within the same tightly sampled manipulation interval.
scene_description: A user traverses a compact kitchen and sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, followed by manipulating two cooker lids and an air-fryer basket.
